resources.string: A place for your reading, discoveries and reflections.
Create an account or sign in
Every journey starts with a chapter.
Verbum currently reads Bíblia Livre in Portuguese and the Berean Standard Bible in English. The World English Bible is also available as an offline fallback in English.
To compare a verse, tap it in the reader and choose Compare. In Portuguese, the comparison uses Bíblia Portuguesa Mundial.
The Bible follows the app language: Portuguese or English. Change the app language in your device settings.

Open a chapter and choose Listen from its menu. The player lets you pause, move forward or back, and return to the chapter. Portuguese audio reads the translation on screen; an English recording may be offered when it is unavailable.
Choose Talk about this chapter to start a conversation. Microphone access is needed only for this feature. You can manage that permission in the device settings.
Chapters you open are recorded on this device from this version onward. Opening a chapter does not mean you have finished reading it.
Your next chapter starts this story.
A verse for the start of your day. You can change this at any time.
Verbum is available in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Use your device settings to choose the language for the app.
Tap the chapter title to choose another book or chapter. Reading preferences let you adjust text size, switch between pages and continuous scrolling, and enable quiet reading.
Tap a verse to open its study panel. Use the bookmark to save it, choose a highlight, or write a note. Find these passages again in Your Verbum.
Previously opened chapters may be available from the cache. Search, study context, voice and new audio may need an internet connection.

Saved passages, highlights, notes and reading history stay on this device. They are not synced by signing in, and they remain on the device after signing out. Personal notes are not sent with study questions.
Your account is used to authenticate access. Account details lets you manage your email, password and account deletion. Deleting your account does not erase local reading data.
When you ask a question or use voice, your question and the relevant study context are sent to the service to produce a response. Microphone access is requested when you start a voice conversation.
You found the verse. Now understand it. Verbum brings reading, context and connections together, so your exploration can begin with Scripture.
How would you like to be called?
Enter your new email and current password. Your address changes only after you verify the new email.
Check your new email to confirm the change, then refresh your account details.
We will send a secure password reset link to your account email.
Your reading, saved on this device.
Tap a verse while reading to save it, highlight it or add a note.
